names: names: each control has the name that the page shows
keyboard: the menubar and the toolbar are 1 tab stop each, and a separator takes no focus
keyboard: Tab goes from the menubar to the toolbar and back
keyboard: ArrowRight and ArrowLeft move between the menus, and Tab comes back to the last one
keyboard: ArrowDown opens a menu on its first item, Enter runs it, and focus goes back to the trigger
keyboard: Escape closes a menu and runs nothing, and ArrowRight in an open menu opens the next one
keyboard: Space on Show ruler switches it on and off
keyboard: ArrowRight and ArrowLeft move through the toolbar and across its groups, Home and End go to its ends
keyboard: Space and Enter press the focused toggle, and the arrows alone press nothing
keyboard: 1 alignment stays pressed, and the same toggle does not clear it
keyboard: Enter on Insert link runs it
keyboard: focus on a toggle shows its hint, and Escape hides it and keeps focus
agent: an agent presses the toggles, and saves from the File menu
